title: brain's MCP server back into aip-836d, last checkpoint
quote: Yes: put it back into aip-836d as its last checkpoint.
means: aip-836d builds brain's MCP server as its own last checkpoint, serving the same verbs brain.mjs exports (d-d9fd). aip-836d gave it to aip-a195 only so it would not wait on aip-a195's Gate A (d-432d); with aip-a195 dropped (d-0603), nothing is left to wait on.

supersedes.what: The MCP server moves back from aip-a195 into aip-836d, as its last checkpoint.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-9271 that held
reflection.result: supersedes d-432d (whole); closes the conflict d-0603 left with d-432d
